startup.failed: Startup failed. Check the application status and try again.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.api_body: API requests failed {{count}} times in a row. Requests were stopped to prevent the app from hanging during loading.
crash.api_clock_body: The local clock differs from the server by about {{minutes}} minute(s), which can invalidate API signatures.
crash.api_fingerprint_body: The Shumei device-fingerprint endpoint failed {{count}} times in a row. This is usually caused by an incorrect system time or time zone. Restart your computer, sync the time zone, then try again.
crash.pending_crash_hint: A crash was detected during the previous run. Error details and the crash report were saved. You can review them or export diagnostics.
crash.cause_clock: The local system time is inaccurate, causing API signature validation to fail.
crash.cause_network: The network connection failed, or a proxy/firewall blocked the request.
crash.cause_auth: The login credential has expired. Please sign in again.
crash.cause_permission: The app lacks permission to access a file or folder, or the disk is full.
crash.cause_data: Local cache or configuration data is corrupted and cannot be parsed.
crash.cause_api: The server keeps returning errors; the service may be temporarily unavailable.
crash.cause_timeout: Loading took too long. Some requests may be stuck.
crash.cause_fingerprint: The Shumei device-fingerprint endpoint keeps failing; the system time, time zone, or fingerprint environment is abnormal.
crash.suggestion_clock: Open Windows Settings > Time & language > Date & time, enable Set time automatically, sync now, then click Retry.
crash.suggestion_network: Check the network connection, disable or adjust proxies, then retry.
crash.suggestion_auth: Open the Account page and sign in again.
crash.suggestion_permission: Run the app with normal permissions and make sure the target disk has enough free space.
crash.suggestion_data: Try reloading or restarting the app. If it keeps failing, export diagnostics and report them.
crash.suggestion_api: Try again later. If it keeps failing, export diagnostics and report them.
crash.suggestion_timeout: Export diagnostics and restart the app. If it still hangs, report the logs.
crash.suggestion_unknown: Retry or restart the app. If the problem persists, export diagnostics and report them.
crash.suggestion_fingerprint: Restart your computer, enable Set time zone automatically and Set time automatically in system settings, sync now, then click Retry in the app.
crash.startup_timeout_detail: {{count}} request(s) are still pending. Check the network connection or system time, then click Reload.
crash.startup_timeout_hint: Startup has not responded for a long time. Check the network connection, system time, or backend process, then click Reload.
crash.log_dir_failed: Could not open the log folder: {{error}}
